short_description: Build and support partner integrations end to end, from each partner's requirements to production.
description: Built the foundation of a new partner integration from scratch (infrastructure, development lifecycle, and tooling) so energy plans display securely and reliably.
Built automated alerting and monitoring that catches integration errors early, then drove each incident to resolution with detailed tickets and immediate code fixes.
Defined project scope and requirements from in-depth reviews of partner API documentation, and coordinated cross-organization meetings.
Built developer tooling that automates AWS S3 and DynamoDB data workflows, speeding up testing and data verification; the team quickly adopted it into its workflow and CI/CD pipeline.
Used AI coding agents (Claude Code) in daily development to speed up implementation, testing, and code review.
Mentored mid-level and senior engineers, speeding up their onboarding onto the core system.

short_description: Maintained and enhanced a microservices-based video-on-demand (VOD) platform.
description: Maintained the Go microservices behind core VOD processing (audio, video, subtitles, media assets, and DRM) and monitored their health to keep production stable.
Added automated testing to the CI/CD pipeline as a quality gate for microservice deployments, catching issues before they reached production.
Ran continuous static analysis and refactoring, raising code quality scores across the VOD services.
Trained new engineers on the end-to-end VOD encoding pipeline and QA process, cutting their ramp-up time.

short_description: Built and optimized secure APIs for construction loan management and on-site inspections.
description: Designed and deployed a private API for construction loan management with on-site inspection features, following the OpenAPI Specification and architecture best practices.
Cut CPU usage by 50% by optimizing the API calls behind credential management.
